signalsProseBlock: Four Matrice-class airframes held tight formation (cohesion 0.92 vs 0.75 threshold) and executed a 4-minute dwell over the primary runway threshold, then transited east and passed within 45 metres of the ILS Glideslope 04L ground installation. Classification revised from unknown to hostile at T+4 minutes.
